name: claude-usage
description: All your ccswitch accounts in the sidebar: 5h/weekly usage, most headroom, one-click switch, auto-switch

commands.title: Claude Usage: Toggle auto-switch to most headroom

claudeUsage.autoSwitch.description: When your current seat hits 100% (5-hour or weekly), switch Claude Code to the seat with most headroom via ccswitch. Running sessions still need a restart.

claudeUsage.usageFile.description: Leave empty to use ccswitch's own usage cache. Set to a team snapshot (CtrlA hub usage.json) to show shared seats instead.
